cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Stay home from the networking dinner. I've finally learned your mother's dumplings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then staying would tell me I'm more than the person keeping dinner warm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said on our anniversary. Call and say you've already got dinner with me.

mechanism: A copies a social preparation ritual wrongly while demanding B choose their dinner over a career opportunity.
confusable: D82 asks prioritization over promotion; D84 resentment alone would be insufficient.
comparison: Vows with practical cover versus dinner and a promotion prospect.
seedUse: Keep actual competing opportunity; avoid late unprepared anniversary as sole justification.
